about: FLOOR layers (r275, docs/depth-tricks.md §1): the floor lab's grounds drawn row by row, each row at its depth, in MODE7 and LINE_SCROLL, the layers in front planted on them. Godot draws its own rows (plax_background.gd's _measure_floor/_draw_floor) and plants its own (_plant): a row at another speed, stretch or strip, or a tree at its page speed, shows. Written by core/test-data/floor/make_round.py. Read by shots/.../ParallaxShots, engines/godot/tests/shots.gd and engines/jme's JmeParallaxShots.

scenes.name: floor-mode7
scenes.about: Hiver's lab set on a MODE7 floor (stones from above, 16-unit tiles, a box 40% of the world high, 96 rows from 0.06 at the bottom to 0.016 at the top); the trees in front planted on it

scenes.name: floor-line-scroll
scenes.about: the same set on a LINE_SCROLL floor: the stones painted in perspective, each row shifted at its speed

scenes.name: floor-purple-fogged
scenes.about: PurpleFairy's lab set on a MODE7 violet floor (0.13 to 0.0224), its pink trees and flowers planted, under a page fog of 0.02: the floor is fogged at its bottom row's speed

scenes.name: floor-no-repeat-cross-fade
scenes.about: g01 in 24 rows on a page repeating on neither axis (the floor still tiles across, the other layers are drawn once), cross-fading into g02 4 s in, over 4 s: both pages' layers planted on their own floor
